name: Brand Studio UI docs
positioning: The public reference for @brand-studio/ui: every component live, in any brand, with code you can copy.
audience: React developers and coding agents deciding which component fits a job and looking for working usage code.
voice: Exact: name the prop, the element and the behaviour
Plain: short sentences, no marketing adjectives
Honest: fictional demo brands are labelled as fictional

direction.tier: Reference docs: reading speed first. The chrome stays greyscale so the only colour on screen comes from the demo brand.
devices: Hero: a large headline over the brand board. The board shows brand tabs, the picked brand's contract values and an uneven grid of live components; picking a tab re-skins the board in a circle that spreads from the tab
The board's Yours tab sets the accent, corner radius and typeface by hand, and every card and the contract line follow as you drag
A field of ink dots behind the board, fading out at its edges; it echoes the dotted VoiceOrb
One brand switch re-skins every live demo on the site at once
Top bar: offset-cards mark with version pill, centred search with a shortcut hint, framed icon buttons
Board cells share hairline gaps in the brand's line colour, so the grid reads as one surface
A greyscale offset-card mascot above the hero lead, beside it on phones; the real component cards remain the product demonstration
An asset creation section below the component examples links to the skill workflows for mascots, sticker-style artwork and icons, and shows the Deskhand mascot contact sheet as example output
invariants: Greyscale chrome: colour appears only inside demos
Geist for text, Geist Mono for code
Every component page: preview, installation, usage, examples, accessibility, API reference

imagery.subject: Live component demos; the only photography is the Still coffee set reused from the showcase; a generated offset-card mascot appears only in the landing hero; the Deskhand mascot contact sheet shows skill output in the asset creation section
imagery.materials: Flat white and near-black surfaces with hairline borders
imagery.lighting: Flat; no shadows on the chrome
imagery.palette: Greyscale chrome; demo brands supply all colour
invariants: Demos render the real package, never screenshots
All demo brands share the Still coffee images
The mascot keeps its greyscale paper-card identity across demo brands and modes
avoid: Invented adoption numbers, logos or testimonials
Mock screenshots in place of live components

motion.character: Quiet: the brand and mode switch crossfade; components carry their own motion. The mascot enters once, tilts on hover and greets on activation; it has no continuous idle animation.
motion.reducedMotion: No transitions; every state and all content stay reachable.

chapters.question: What is in the package?
chapters.visual: Hero copy, then the brand board of live demos, then the intro film.
chapters.transition: A board tab re-skins the board in a circle from the tab; the header switch crossfades.
chapters.mobileFallback: Single-column board, voice orb first; tabs and contract values wrap above it.

chapters.question: How do I use this component?
chapters.message: See it live, then copy the code.
chapters.visual: Preview with collapsible code, then install, usage, examples and props.
chapters.mobileFallback: Preview at full width above the code.
